About this item

  • HANES QUALITY - Men’s tees are made with a high-density stitch count, double-needle stitching, and shoulder-to-shoulder taping.
  • HOLDS ITS SHAPE - The ribbed crewneck lays flat and holds its shape for a tee that's made to last.
  • ROOM TO MOVE - A full cut in these men’s undershirts gives you extra room to move.
  • COTTON GOODNESS - Soft and strong 6-oz. ringspun cotton feels great for comfort that lasts. (Heathered colors are a cotton blend.)
  • BIG & TALL SIZES - Need more room? These classic men's short-sleeve tees are available in Big Men's sizes up to 6XL.
  • COLD WATER WASH - Hanes recommends washing this men's t-shirt in cold water to reduce energy usage.

  • James & Gabrielle
    5 out of 5 stars
    Definitely Beefy - Nice, Thick Shirt!
    Reviewed in the United States on May 15, 2026
    Size: 3X-LargeColor: Charcoal HeatherNumber of Items: 1
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I purchased this T-shirt on Black Friday at a really low price because I was looking for just a simple one-color shirt to wear underneath hoodies during the winter. I wanted something comfortable, soft, and something that wouldn’t shrink immediately after washing it. I also wanted it to be versatile enough where I could either layer it or just wear it by itself around the house or out running errands.

    At first, I honestly didn’t know what Hanes meant by “Beefy-T,” but after getting it, I completely understand the name now. This is a thick T-shirt, and I mean that in a good way. The material feels substantial and much higher quality than a lot of the thinner shirts out there right now.

    As a bigger guy, finding T-shirts can honestly be very hit or miss. Sometimes an extra large doesn’t really feel like a true extra large, and the sizing gets weird the bigger you go. This shirt actually felt roomy in a comfortable way. It had coverage to it. I felt warm wearing it, and it almost seemed intentionally made a little beefier and more relaxed fitting, which worked perfectly for me.

    It ended up being extremely comfortable underneath a hoodie because of the softness and thickness, but it also looked perfectly fine wearing it by itself too. For the price I paid, I was honestly impressed with the quality.

    I highly recommend this T-shirt, especially for bigger guys who are tired of thin shirts that feel undersized or cheaply made.

    I am incredibly happy with this Beefy-T. As a bigger guy, finding t-shirts that have a true tall fit without being ridiculously wide or shrinking into a crop top after one wash is tough, but these are spot-on. The cotton is thick, heavy, and feels high-quality and durable.     I'm 5'6" and weight around 385, and the 4XT fits great. This is the 2nd time I've ordered these, and I've purchased a variety of colors. My lady has essentially stolen them from me.

    The fabric is soft and I like the comfort, wearability, and lack of clinginess. They also haven't shrunk at all after a couple times through the laundry, which is nice. I especially like how thick these shirts are. My only real complaints are: 1) they wrinkle easily; 2) the collar is kinda loose after you put it on and take it off- they don't really stay flat; and 3) as mentioned before, my lady keeps wearing them, so I feel like she gets more use out of them than me.

    Overall, I'd say the shirts are worth what I paid for them. I could probably find other shirts that are "more perfect" but would end up paying a lot more. And these look good enough that I'm not dissatisfied.

About this Item

  • HANES QUALITY - Men’s tees are made with a high-density stitch count, double-needle stitching, and shoulder-to-shoulder taping.
  • HOLDS ITS SHAPE - The ribbed crewneck lays flat and holds its shape for a tee that's made to last.
  • ROOM TO MOVE - A full cut in these men’s undershirts gives you extra room to move.
  • COTTON GOODNESS - Soft and strong 6-oz. ringspun cotton feels great for comfort that lasts. (Heathered colors are a cotton blend.)
  • BIG & TALL SIZES - Need more room? These classic men's short-sleeve tees are available in Big Men's sizes up to 6XL.
  • COLD WATER WASH - Hanes recommends washing this men's t-shirt in cold water to reduce energy usage.

Product Description

Hanes® Beefy-T® t-shirts set the standard for comfort and quality more than 45 years ago. Not much has changed in the half-century since. Crafted from heavyweight 6-oz. cotton with double-needle stitching and a high-density stitch count, these classic men’s tees still feature shoulder-to-shoulder taping for extra strong seams and a shape-holding, lay-flat crewneck. Boasting a roomier fit, this better-than-basic men’s crewneck tee gives you plenty of room to move. Pair these men’s t-shirts with jeans for a timeless top layer or layer under a sweater or jacket for a look that continues to work – even after all these years.
